change: Construct pump_differential_output.PumpReport after argument parsing and publish through it, exactly as the Fees, Pump migrate/holder/amm-create and eleven other PumpReport families do. The publisher refuses a destination that is an input (by resolved path, directory containment, symlink or hardlink), rechecks for a late alias, stages the bytes and fsyncs them, and only then replaces a prior report, so a failed run cannot truncate one. evidence/original/mayhem/deployed.so is passed as an extra input because the shared defaults do not name it.
